69:1: That which will come to pass.
69:2: What is that which comes to pass?
69:3: What is the truth, what made you know?
69:4: Thamud and 'Ad denied the striking calamity.
69:5: Thus Thamud was destroyed by the rebellious (blast).
69:6: And the people of 'Ad were destroyed by a fierce, freezing wind.
69:7: He imposed it upon them consecutively for seven nights and eight days, so you would see the people therein fallen down, as if they were date-palm logs.
69:8: So do you see anything remaining of them?
69:9: Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities came with error.
69:10: They rebelled against the messenger of their Rabb, so He seized them with a severe seizure.
69:11: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you in the ship.
69:12: That We might make it an admonition for you and that retaining ears might comprehend it.
69:13: When a single blowing is blown into the Sur,
69:14: When the earth and the mountains are carried away and crushed with a single strike.
69:15: On that Day, that which is to happen comes to pass.
69:16: The heaven splits apart, and on that Day it is frail.
69:17: The angels are at its edges, and on that Day eight will bear the Throne of your Rabb above them.
69:18: On that Day you are presented; no hidden thing of yours remains hidden.
69:19: And thus, to whomever his book was brought by his right hand, he says, 'Here, take, read my book!'
69:20: Indeed, I thought that I would meet my account.
69:21: So he is in a well-pleasing life.
69:24: Eat and drink with good health, in return for what you sent forth in the days gone by.
69:25: And as for him whose book was brought by his left hand, then he says, 'Ah, would that I had not been given my book!'
69:26: And I had not known what my account was.
69:27: Would that it had been the ending one.
69:28: My wealth did not avail me anything.
69:29: My power has perished from me.
69:32: Then insert him into a chain whose length is seventy cubits.
69:33: Because he did not believe in Allah, the Most High.
69:34: And did not encourage feeding the poor.
69:35: There is not for him here today any close friend.
69:36: There is no food except pus.
69:37: None eats it except the sinners.
69:38: Nay, I swear by what you see.
69:39: And I swear by what you do not see.
69:40: Indeed, it is the word of a noble messenger.
69:41: And it is not the word of a poet; how little you believe!
69:42: And not with the word of a soothsayer; how little you reflect!
69:43: Sent down from the Rabb of the worlds.
69:44: If he had fabricated some sayings against Us,
69:45: We would have seized him by the right hand (or from the right side).
69:46: Then We would surely have cut off the jugular vein from him.
69:47: None of you could have prevented it from him.
69:48: And indeed, it is an admonition for the God-fearing.
69:49: And indeed, We surely know that among you are deniers.
69:50: And indeed, it is a regret upon the disbelievers.
69:52: So glorify the great name of your Rabb.
